title: I think I have been going to this world for months and found this sub today, here's my dream from last night
content: I dreamt I was in a futuristic looking bar and was talking to the bartenders about what I should order. I ordered some fruit, I think it may have only served fruit. Every order came in a small potted plant which the fruit grew in and you ate it from the plant. I accidentally ate someone else's order thinking it was mine. It was a small bunch of grapes that I picked off and I think the bartender told me that I ate someone else's lol. I apologized profusely then went to a different area of this mall with a woman. I think she is a friend of mine who I had another one of these mall dreams with in December last year. In this dream we were looking around a store that had pretty much everything and I think we were shopping for something for her son. &#x200B; Everything felt incredibly realistic and very familiar, like I knew everyone and knew this place. It was my second "home" in a way. I plan on posting more from my journal but this is blowing my mind!
